description: Add one file to an agent skill by uploading it. A DOCX or PDF is stored as its extracted text and anything else is decoded as UTF-8; content beyond the per-file character limit is truncated rather than rejected. The path, duplicate, file-count, and editability rules match skills.resources.create, which takes the text directly as JSON.

alternative.limitation: creates a resource from text `content`; a binary DOCX/PDF resource has no JSON form
